title: Obstructive kidney distal transport programs: donor and animal-level reanalysis code and data
description: Code, verified donor aggregates, expected result tables and figure scripts for a 12-donor secondary analysis of GSE254185. Tumour type and obstruction status are completely confounded; the results describe transcript scores and do not establish physiological transport or an isolated obstruction effect. This version adds primary snRNA and secondary scRNA cross-injury analyses from the Lake et al. atlas, with partial support and complete null/untestable results. The GSE96102 public mouse extension includes verified fluorescence inputs, fixed target orthology, 71 matched-comparison arrays, complete animal-level contrasts and acquisition-date/detectability sensitivities. Acquisition era limits temporal interpretation.
